hn-50180836.t: PHP2Shell: AI uncovers critical RCE in PHP
hn-50180836.s: Core PHP engine flaws enable remote code execution and Heartbleed-style memory disclosure across the web.
ex: In this post, we explain how frontier AI helped us find and fix vulnerabilities that had remained hidden in the PHP codebase for more than a decade. The issues described below all stem from key architecture decisions, some made over a decade ago, and were grouped under two CVEs, with severity reaching CVSS 9.2. The work grew into a cross-industry effort to protect customers, find variants, deploy detections and mitigations, and verify a patch in time for coordinated disclosure. Nearly every PHP version is affected by at least one of these issues, including releases dating back to PHP 5.4. The vulnerabilities can allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on affected servers or read sensitive process memory. That memory may contain passwords, authentication tokens, API keys and certificates belonging to other requests or the server itself. PHP is the programming language behind much of the web, powering WordPress, Drupal and MediaWiki, the software that runs Wikipedia.

hn-50180873.s: PHP 8.2.35 is out with fixes for the critical security vulnerabilities disclosed this week; sites on the 8.2 branch should upgrade soon.
ex: PHP is a popular general-purpose scripting language that is especially suited to web development. Fast, flexible and pragmatic, PHP powers everything from your blog to the most popular websites in the world. PHP is distributed under the Modified BSD License (SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause). Prebuilt packages and binaries can be used to get up and running fast with PHP. For Windows, the PHP binaries can be obtained from windows.php.net. After extracting the archive the .exe files are ready to use. For a minimal PHP build from Git, you will need autoconf, bison, and re2c. For a default build, you will additionally need libxml2 and libsqlite3. Configure your build. --enable-debug is recommended for development, see ./configure --help for a full list of options. Build PHP. To speed up the build, specify the maximum number of jobs using the -j argument: The number of jobs should usually match the number of available cores, which can be determined using nproc.

hn-50182987.t: Today's PHP security release, and how we're strengthening security
hn-50182987.s: Describing the story behind how critical security vulnerabilities were found and fixed.
ex: Earlier today, the PHP project released PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, and 8.2.35. These releases fix two critical vulnerabilities that, under the right conditions, allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute code on servers running PHP. If you run PHP, it is imperative that you update now. The announcement on php.net contains and references technical details on the vulnerabilities, attack vectors, and instructions on how to update on which systems. This post isn't about how to update. It's about how these vulnerabilities were found and fixed, what has changed in how PHP security is handled over the past two years, and what we need from the organizations that depend on PHP to keep PHP's security work going. Both issues sit in parts of PHP that nearly every request touches: memory management and error handling.

hn-50172041.t: Security advisory: Critical remote code execution vulnerabilities, update now
hn-50172041.s: php.net security advisory: several critical remote code execution vulnerabilities are fixed, and all users are urged to update to the latest patch releases now.
ex: Here are the most important news items we have published in 2026 on PHP.net. PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35 fix two critical vulnerabilities that can allow unauthenticated remote code execution. All PHP users are strongly encouraged to update immediately. Who is at risk: all PHP installations serving web requests, including PHP-FPM, Apache with mod_php, php-cgi, FrankenPHP and LiteSpeed. We consider the risk highest for mod_php, with a demonstrated exploit where an unauthenticated request can trigger the attack before any application code runs. If you cannot update immediately: while only an update is a complete solution, the following measures reduce exposure to specific attack paths but do not make an installation safe. The advisories linked above have the full technical details. The PHP development team announces the immediate availability of PHP 8.5.12.

hn-50186215.t: Meta hit with $25B penalty for deceiving users about privacy on Facebook
hn-50186215.s: Following a jury verdict finding nearly 44 million violations of state law, New Mexico secures a massive financial penalty in its Cambridge Analytica case
ex: Following a jury verdict finding nearly 44 million violations of state law, New Mexico secures a massive financial penalty in its Cambridge Analytica case Santa Fe, N.M. — New Mexico Attorney General Raúl Torrez today announced a historic financial victory in the State’s landmark Cambridge Analytica case against Facebook, following a court order requiring the company to pay $25 billion in civil penalties for violations of New Mexico’s Unfair Practices Act. New Mexico has secured one of the largest financial penalties against a corporation in U.S. history, and a landmark victory holding Facebook accountable under state consumer protection law. It follows a jury verdict finding that Facebook committed 43,899,725 violations of New Mexico law, a staggering number of violations that reflects the scope of the company’s unlawful conduct toward New Mexicans. “This is a historic day for New Mexico and for consumers across the country,” said Attorney General Raúl Torrez.

hn-50186518.t: After automation: Solo founding will be the default
hn-50186518.s: Julian Weisser is the founder and CEO of Solo Founders and a cofounder of On Deck.
ex: Julian Weisser is the founder and CEO of Solo Founders and a cofounder of On Deck. I spent the last seven years helping ambitious people navigate the biggest barrier to starting successful companies: finding cofounders. Back then, cofounders were considered an essential ingredient for starting a startup. Building and selling were each full-time jobs, and there was simply too much for one person to do. Because of this, most successful companies from Facebook to Airbnb had cofounders. That led to the idea of two (or more) cofounders in a garage or dorm room becoming a core part of Silicon Valley romanticism. You'll notice that I wrote the prior paragraph in the past tense. That’s because things have changed. The amount of human hours required to build something useful and get it in front of customers has collapsed. With AI, it takes less time and money to get started than ever before. This is why, after automation, solo founding will be the default way to start startups.

hn-50175779.t: Using Claude to reduce the attack surface of code
hn-50175779.s: Automated attack surface analysis and reduction can meaningfully improve the security of deployed software in the near term.
ex: Over the past year, we’ve published lots of data that shows that frontier AI models are more than capable of discovering and exploiting security vulnerabilities. Showing how previously unknown vulnerabilities might be exploited is, however, only the start of what frontier AI models can do for cyber defense. In this post, we summarize some of our initial research into automated attack surface analysis and reduction: the process of using AI models to map the code that is reachable, then removing or restricting access to anything than a given deployment doesn’t need to expose. Automated attack surface analysis and reduction can meaningfully improve the security of deployed software in the near term. Securing software by finding and fixing individual vulnerabilities alone scales poorly: fixing even a critical vulnerability tells you nothing about the vulnerabilities that remain.

hn-50170021.t: Claude designed protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins
hn-50170021.s: We asked an internal research Claude model to design minibinders (small proteins that attach tightly to a target) against scorpion neurotoxins.
ex: Summary: As part of our work experimenting with how Claude can help accelerate drug discovery, we asked an internal research model to design minibinders (small proteins that attach tightly to a target) against scorpion neurotoxins. Claude worked from our prompt and four follow-ups, which we developed in collaboration with the financial investment research firm Citrini Research. Teams at Adaptyv Bio and Twist Bioscience experimentally tested 211 designs for binding. Of these, 17 met our criteria. We’re releasing all 211 designs and their data as a resource for the field. In August, we showed how Claude designed protein minibinders after being given a single prompt. A month before we released those results, a team from Citrini Research had approached us with an interesting question: could Claude (and AI drug discovery more generally) enable a group of motivated nonexperts to tackle a genuine problem in human health?

Headings, forms, tables, cards, accordions, modals and navigation are styled from the HTML element alone. - Light and dark mode. It follows the visitor's system setting automatically, and data-theme lets you force either mode. - Easy to theme. Every color, font, size and radius is a CSS custom property. - Easy to override. hn-50176077.s: CORRECTED FINDINGS (2026-10-21): Cached-pointer chain DEAD at the addref (session.c:3213 Z_TRY_ADDREF keeps array alive - no free, no RCE, CVSS 0.0).
ex: CORRECTED FINDINGS (2026-10-21): Cached-pointer chain DEAD at the addref (session.c:3213 Z_TRY_ADDREF keeps array alive - no free, no RCE, CVSS 0.0). The real bug is a serialize-state cross-request UAF (ASAN-confirmed at var.c:756, n+=1 on arrays/references, prefork-only, NOT code execution, CVSS 5.3 Medium). Full proof + receipts preserved; lab details unredacted. PHP's session.upload_progress handler (php_session_rfc1867_callback in ext/session/session.c) runs inside php_hash_environment, BEFORE zend_activate_modules and therefore BEFORE PHP_RINIT_FUNCTION(basic) zeroes BG(serialize) / BG(unserialize) (basic_functions.c:393-395). Both globals cache { level, data } for the var layer. A memory_limit bailout inside the pre-RINIT update() decode/encode leaves the context allocated but level=1 with a dangling data pointer.

hn-50175510.t: C# now beats Rust on WASM size
hn-50175510.s: Compile C# and .NET CIL to small standalone Wasm with WASI (AOT with built-in Runtime and Precise GC)
ex: Independent .NET for WebAssembly and WASI. Write C#. Deploy small, standalone Wasm. NetWasm is an independent compiler, CoreLib, runtime and SDK that compiles C# and .NET CIL directly to WebAssembly. It does not carry the desktop CLR, Mono, dotnet.js or application DLLs into production. Compile C# to WebAssembly · Try it in the browser · Install and build · See supported APIs · Read the documentation NetWasm + precise GC: 47,895 bytes Rust 1.95.0 size-oriented profile: 53,635 bytes For the same print-42 workload, NetWasm's result includes the runtime and precise Compact garbage collector. Both artifacts are standalone WASI Preview 2 Components, built the way a developer gets them out of the box: each toolchain's standard library and ordinary build, with no hand-added tools. Rust is the headline comparison because it uses the same workload and output form. Kotlin/Wasm and TinyGo show the broader footprint landscape, but their targets and runtime boundaries differ.

hn-50181326.t: Cloudflare deploys protections against php2shell vulnerability
hn-50181326.s: Cloudflare has deployed default web application firewall (WAF) protections for newly disclosed PHP vulnerabilities before public disclosure.
ex: Today, Calif.io, Wiz, OpenAI and Quarkslab disclosed two vulnerabilities in PHP, tracked as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 and known as php2shell. The vulnerabilities affect all web servers running PHP 5.4 or later and they may allow an attacker to cause denial of service, remote code execution, and data exposure when an application processes specially crafted HTTP traffic. Cloudflare has been part of a coordinated effort to deploy mitigations to protect the Internet, working with PHP foundation, OpenAI and Wiz among others. Cloudflare has developed and deployed web application firewall (WAF) protections since early October 2026, which were deployed about 9 hours ahead of public disclosure. Starting on October 21 3:02 am UTC, Cloudflare customers using our free or paid WAF were protected by default against php2shell.

gh-1428058681.s: CVE-2026-109618/109619 PHP session.upload_progress Exploit Research — POC & Analysis
ex: php2shell CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619 — PHP Pre-Auth RCE Exploit & Detection Toolkit Five independent RCE chains exploiting PHP's session.uploadprogress and the Zend engine's OOM bailout. 14 years of vulnerable code — PHP 5.4.0 (2012) through 8.5.11. Pre-auth. No application vulnerability required for some chains. Impacts 78% of all websites — including WordPress (43%), Joomla, Drupal, Laravel, Magento, and every default PHP installation. Author: Qi Deng | Writeup: Substack | Date: 2026-10-21 Patch: Commit 3584a98 — 300 files changed across the Zend engine. Chain D is the most critical: zero-dependency pre-auth RCE against any Apache modphp installation. No LFI, no app vulnerability, no authentication — just a single multipart POST. Three RCE exploits (Chains A, B, C) are included in exploit/: Chains D and E exploits are available to paid subscribers. Fastest mitigation: block PHPSESSIONUPLOADPROGRESS in multipart POST bodies.

The same analysis finds three skills repeated in every job description: RAG, Agents, and Evals. Per LinkedIn Jobs on the Rise 2026, AI Engineer is the fastest-growing job in the US, with 143% growth. This roadmap takes a beginner through those skills in five layers, each ending in a mini-project you can show. For job titles and the rest of the numbers, see Careers. - Layer by layer. Pick a layer, finish its mini-project, and move on to the next. - On a schedule. Follow the 12-week sample plan. Each layer budget assumes ~10 hrs/week.
